uncoveredRules.name: account-balance-positive
uncoveredRules.description: A bank account balance must never go below $0.00. Any transaction (withdrawal or transfer) that would result in a negative balance must be rejected with HTTP 422 and error code INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.

uncoveredRules.name: transfer-daily-limit
uncoveredRules.description: A customer may not transfer more than $50,000 in aggregate within a rolling 24-hour window. Attempts to exceed this limit must be rejected with HTTP 422 and error code TRANSFER_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

uncoveredRules.name: loan-eligibility-check
uncoveredRules.description: Customers must have a minimum credit score of 620 to qualify for a personal loan and 680 for a mortgage. Applications below the threshold are rejected with HTTP 422, status REJECTED, and a reason containing "credit".

uncoveredRules.name: loan-payment-schedule
uncoveredRules.description: Loan repayments must match the pre-computed amortization schedule within ±$1.00. Payments that deviate from the scheduled amount must be rejected with HTTP 422 and error code LOAN_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_MISMATCH.

uncoveredRules.name: savings-minimum-balance
uncoveredRules.description: Savings accounts have a mandatory minimum balance (defined at account opening). Withdrawal requests that would bring the balance below the minimum must be rejected with HTTP 422 and error code MINIMUM_BALANCE_VIOLATION.

uncoveredRules.name: beneficiary-verification
uncoveredRules.description: Fund transfers can only be sent to beneficiaries whose verified flag is true. Transfers to unverified beneficiaries must be rejected with HTTP 422 and error code BENEFICIARY_NOT_VERIFIED.

uncoveredRules.name: dormant-account-restrictions
uncoveredRules.description: Accounts that have had no activity for 12+ months are automatically marked DORMANT. No withdrawals, transfers, or outgoing transactions may be initiated on dormant accounts. Attempts must return HTTP 422.

uncoveredRules.name: two-factor-for-large-transfers
uncoveredRules.description: Transfers exceeding $10,000 require the customer to have completed a Two-Factor Authentication challenge in the current session. Attempting such a transfer without 2FA must return HTTP 403 and error code TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED.
